newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close lower on locals selling.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close lower on locals selling.

text.p: Selling by locals wary about holding stocks over the long holiday weekend overcame buying support from foreign investors and drove the Thai stock index slightly lower on Friday, brokers said.

"Foreigners accumulated some bank, energy and finance issues today as they believed the market had been oversold. The market was sluggish like in the past few days as locals left the market earlier ahead of the long weekend holidays," said Somchai Trairattanapirom of SITCA Investment and Securities.
The composite SET index fell 1.71 points to 713.62 on 2.6 billion baht turnover.
The SET-50 index dipped 0.23 point to 53.53.
The market will be closed on April 14-15 for the traditional Thai New Year holidays.
Plans by finance companies to release their first quarter earnings by April 21 also caused investors to stay on the sidelines today, brokers said.
The banking sector was first-ranked in terms of value, declining 0.39 percent, followed by the communication sector gaining 0.44 percent.
Krung Thai Bank topped the actve list, falling 0.50 baht to 37. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
